quote: we prompted GPT-4 Turbo (gpt-4-1106-preview) using the OpenAI Python API. GPT-4 Turbo was presented with a system prompt containing the same instructions (in Spanish) that were presented to human participants, explaining the purpose of the task. Then, for each sentence pair, Turbo was presented with the same instructions given to human participants (again in Spanish) asking them to rate the relatedness of the target word across the two contexts.
methods: rating relatedness of ambiguous words in context

quote: We recruited an initial pool of 139 participants through Prolific. Participants received $2.40 for participating and the median completion time was 12 minutes and 23 seconds, for an average rate of $11.64 per hour.
guideline: Participants were instructed to rate each word on a scale from 1 (totalmente sin relación, "totally unrelated") to 5 (mismo significado, "same meaning") for a given target word, using information provided by the context cue across the sentence pair.
